reviews.title: Shady app and a waste of money and time
reviews.text:
This app used to be good, but now it feels extremely money-driven and frustrating to use. You download the app thinking you can use it to meet someone for marriage, but almost every useful feature seems to require another payment. First you pay to use the app, then you’re pushed toward boosts, diamonds, and other upgrades just to see who liked you or actually use basic features.

Even after setting very specific filters, the app still shows people who are nowhere near what I selected, which makes the filters feel almost pointless. Then you’re encouraged to pay even more just to have a better experience.

What makes this especially disappointing is that the company markets itself around Islam, Muslim marriage, and good intentions. Unfortunately, the experience now feels more like a business designed to continuously get money from its users than a service genuinely focused on helping Muslims get married.

I tried giving the app another chance because I remember when it was much better, but I regret downloading it again. The constant paywalls and upselling are incredibly frustrating. In my opinion, this app has lost sight of its original purpose, and it’s very disappointing to see a platform that claims to help Muslims find marriage become so focused on making users pay again and again just to use it.

I used to really like this app, but it has completely gone downhill. If you are thinking about paying for Diamond Premium, save your money because the core features simply do not work anymore.
First off, the filters are completely broken. The main reason you pay for premium is to filter by ethnicity, distance, and language, but the app constantly shows you people way outside of your set preferences. And this isn't a case of "running out of people" in your area—the algorithm will just randomly throw in people from outside your filters, then go back to your actual preferences, making the whole system incredibly frustrating to navigate. Without working filters, the premium membership is completely worthless.
On top of that, they completely removed the anti-ghosting feature for Diamond members, which was one of the few benefits actually worth paying for. The new interface is terrible and a huge step backward. You can no longer keep track of people’s saved profiles to message them later, and there’s absolutely no record of who you liked or favorited. You just swipe into a void.
To make matters worse, customer service is non-existent. I’ve reached out with complaints about these bugs and missing features, and I've gotten zero response. It genuinely feels like the developers deliberately want their own app to suffer and fail. Until they fix the filters and bring back basic usability, I highly recommend staying away from their paid tiers.

However, every time I attempt to reinstate my subscription, I am met with the message, “Oops, something has gone wrong,” and this has been happening for several days now.

I have emailed Salaam on at least six occasions and have received only one response. To make matters worse, even when I try to purchase a new subscription simply to avoid the inconvenience the app will not allow me to do so. Once you manage to access the app, the experience deteriorates even further.

If a member of the Salaam administrative team is reading this, I would appreciate it if you could kindly get in touch.

reviews.title: This app went majorly downhill. Not worth it for people seriously looking
reviews.text: I used this app in late 2023/early 2024 and the format was so much better in terms of actually providing meaningful information when creating the profile. Now, most of those questions are answered later by choice. And only 3 max preferences?! That aren’t even meaningfully considered when swiping through profiles?! I even purchased the diamond subscription for one month because I thought surely I’d be able to filter better with it and see people who like me. But there was no improvement in filtering and profiles I already pressed X on get shown to me again. This app is really really useless. Muzz is much better. The only thing going for this app is that it seems like everyone is in US/Canada, which matters for some people.
